steps: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large high-sided skillet over medium heat. Add the diced onion with a pinch of salt and cook until soft and golden, 8-10 minutes.
Add the minced garlic, ground coriander and bay leaf; cook 30 seconds more until fragrant.
Add half the kidney beans and crush with a potato masher until mostly broken down. Stir in the remaining beans, chopped walnuts, balsamic vinegar, tomato paste, maple syrup and 240 ml water.
Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat to low and simmer until thick and fragrant, about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust salt and pepper. Remove the bay leaf and sprinkle generously with fresh cilantro before serving.
